# CANDIDATE: SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK_OPTIMIZED_PARAMS

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We are testing whether the SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK trigger with optimized parameters can capture edge on J's anchor days (beaterish rejection setup days) while avoiding losses on loser days. The high wide_pnl suggests profitability across many trades, but low edge_capture indicates poor alignment with J's specific winner/loser structure.

## Mechanism

Entry triggers when: volume > 1.3× 20-bar average AND candle body ≥ $0.05 AND minimum 2 stars (confluence signals) AND strike offset = 2 (OTM-2 put) AND proximity to level ≤ $1.5 AND requires break above open. Exit uses: premium stop = -8% (catastrophe cap), TP1 at +40% premium (selling 66.7%), runner target = +150% premium, no profit-lock arming (threshold=0%), profit-lock stop offset = 5% of premium if armed.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=10 requires ~$25K+ account for full risk deployment; $1K paper account would realize ~14% of headline P&L due to 50% per-trade risk cap.
2. **Sample bias:** Grinder evaluated 432 combos; 5 keepers selected (1.2% pass rate). High overfit risk due to selection bias from large parameter sweep without OOS validation.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no walk-forward held-out window performed)
